name: Eternal Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Eternal Limited (previously Zomato Limited) is one of the leading online Food Service platforms in terms of the value of food sold. Its offerings include food delivery, dining-out services, Loyalty programs, and others.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Blinkit (quick commerce) order value growth, medium term
items.quote: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR and that would obviously mean some reasonable store expansion, but we're not planning to give out any specific number guidance on that.
items.actual: 79% year on year in Q2 FY27
items.why: Blinkit's order value grew 79% in Q2, a figure raised on the October call that management did not dispute, and it said growth would pick up further from December.
items.actual_quote: And then when you're guiding for growth to pick up in Blinkit from 79%, are you specifically referring to the December quarter, or is that a more generic comment for the next 12 months?

guidance.note: Eternal publishes its numbers in a shareholder letter; the call transcripts are questions and answers only, so few promises can be checked.

bull.text: Management is delivering: 1 of 1 checkable promises kept or on track
Revenue has compounded 93.7% a year over 5 years
Growth is speeding up: revenue 97.3% a year over 3 years vs 93.7% over 5

bear.text: Free cash flow was negative over 3 years (₹-1,293 cr)

claims.summary: The prepared remarks on the latest calls had no whole-company figures to check; management spoke in segment numbers.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 127% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 12 days to pay, against 24 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 143% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. A large part of profit does not come from the core business.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit fell 31% while operating profit grew 90%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 61%, against 45% on average over the four quarters before. A lower rate flatters profit; a higher one depresses it. Check the notes for why.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.18× equity, against 0.07× two years earlier.

quality.summary: 5 of 7 checks are clean; look at: profit comes from the core business, tax rate is normal.
